mentions.name: Low-level C audio programming libraries
mentions.description: Planned low-level C libraries for audio programming, to be written using The Audio Programming Book as a guide after getting back into audio programming with Pd and Miller Puckette's techniques book.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm getting back in to audio programming, starting off with Pd[1] and reading Miller Puckette's book[2]. I'm planning on writing some low-level C libraries afterwards, using The Audio Programming Book[3] as a guide
